query: In vitro differentiation of murine naïve CD4-positive T cells into Th17 cells
title: A Simple and Robust Protocol for in vitro Differentiation of Mouse Non-pathogenic T Helper 17 Cells from CD4+ T Cells.
markdown:
## Protocol: In vitro differentiation of murine naïve CD4-positive T cells into Th17 cells

### Overview

This protocol outlines the in vitro differentiation of murine naïve CD4-positive T cells into Th17 cells. The process involves preparing specific culture and staining reagents, isolating naïve CD4+ T cells from mouse spleen and lymph nodes, seeding them on antibody-coated plates in polarization medium, and analyzing differentiation via FACS on Day 3 (or Days 2–5). Two analytical branches are supported: standard intracellular staining for wild-type mice or direct GFP analysis for IL17A-IRES-GFP-KI mice.

### Materials/Reagents

- RPMI 1640 1×
- Fetal bovine serum (FBS)
- L-glutamine (2 mM final concentration)
- Sodium pyruvate (1% final concentration)
- Penicillin-Streptomycin (PS) (1% final concentration)
- 2-Mercaptoethanol (2-ME) (1:1,000 final concentration)
- Phosphate-buffered saline (PBS)
- Anti-mouse CD3 antibody (10 μg/ml)
- Anti-mouse CD28 antibody (10 μg/ml)
- Bovine serum albumin (BSA)
- EDTA (0.5 M stock)
- Mouse interleukin-6 (mIL-6) (50 ng/ml)
- Human transforming growth factor-beta 1 (hTGF-β1) (20 ng/ml)
- Anti-mouse IL-2 antibody (8 μg/ml)
- Anti-mouse IL-4 antibody (8 μg/ml)
- Anti-mouse IFN-γ antibody (8 μg/ml)
- Cell Stimulation Cocktail Plus Protein Transport Inhibitors
- Anti-mouse CD4 antibody (1:100 dilution)
- FoxP3 Fixation/Permeabilization Kit
- Anti-IL-17A antibody (1:100 dilution)
- CFSE (optional, for proliferation tracking)

### Equipment

- 48-well plate
- Centrifuge (implied by cell isolation/counting)
- Flow cytometer (FACS)
- CO2 incubator (37°C, 5% CO2)
- Refrigerator (4°C)

### Safety & Sterility

- Store prepared culture media, MACS buffer, and staining buffer at 4°C.
- Filter MACS buffer using a 0.2-μm filter.
- Perform cell staining and fixation steps according to manufacturer instructions to maintain sterility and proper permeabilization.

## Reagent Preparation

### Pre-experiment

1. Prepare culture medium by mixing RPMI 1640 1× with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS), 2 mM L-glutamine, 1% sodium pyruvate, 1% penicillin-streptomycin (PS), and 1:1,000 2-mercaptoethanol (2-ME). Store the medium at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->
2. Prepare the TCR-stimulation antibody mixture by dissolving anti-mouse CD3 and anti-mouse CD28 antibodies in PBS to achieve a final concentration of 10 μg/ml for each antibody. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S02 -->
3. Prepare RBC lysis buffer (1×) by mixing 1 ml of 10× RBC lysis buffer with 9 ml of cell culture grade water. Store the diluted buffer at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S03 -->
4. Prepare MACS buffer by adding 2.5 g bovine serum albumin (BSA) and 2 ml of 0.5 M EDTA to 500 ml of PBS. Filter the solution using a 0.2-μm filter and store at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S04 -->
5. Prepare TH17 polarization medium immediately before use by supplementing the culture medium with mouse IL-6 (50 ng/ml), human TGF-β1 (20 ng/ml), anti-mouse IL-2 antibody (8 μg/ml), anti-mouse IL-4 antibody (8 μg/ml), and anti-mouse IFN-γ antibody (8 μg/ml). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S05 -->
6. Prepare staining buffer by adding 2% (w/v) bovine serum albumin (BSA) to PBS. Store the buffer at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S06 -->

## Naïve CD4+ T cell isolation and seeding

### Day -2

1. On Day -2, pre-coat wells in a 48-well plate with 200 μl of the TCR-stimulating antibody mixture per well and incubate at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S01 -->

### Day 0

1. On Day 0, euthanize a C57BL/6J mouse (or an IL17A-IRES-GFP-KI mouse), harvest the spleen and lymph nodes (LNs), and isolate naïve CD4+ T cells using the MojoSort™ Isolation Kit following the manufacturer's instructions. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S01 -->
2. Count the cells and seed 2.5 × 105 cells/well in the pre-coated 48-well plate with 500 μl TH17
 polarization medium at 37°C/5% CO2. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S02 -->
3. Optional: To track T cell proliferation, stain the naïve CD4+ T cells with CFSE according to the manufacturer's instructions prior to seeding. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S03 -->

## FACS analysis of TH17 cell differentiation

### Day 3 (or anytime between day 2 and day 5)

1. treat the cells for
 4 h with Cell Stimulation Cocktail Plus Protein Transport Inhibitors according to the manufacturer’s [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S01 -->
2. for 4 h, and then stain the cells with the anti-mouse CD4 antibody (1:100) for 30 min at 4°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S02 -->
3. Next,
 fix and permeabilize the cells using the FoxP3 Fixation/Permeabilization Kit according to the
 manufacturer's instructions. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S03 -->
4. Finally, stain the cells with the anti-IL-17A antibody (1:100) at RT for 15
 min before FACS analysis [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S04 -->
5. before FACS analysis (if cultured cells are from an IL17A-IRES-GFP-KI mouse, FACS analysis
 can be performed directly without the procedures described above in B). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S05 -->

#### Branch A: Wild-type or standard differentiation

1. treat the cells for
 4 h with Cell Stimulation Cocktail Plus Protein Transport Inhibitors according to the manufacturer’s
 for 4 h, and then stain the cells with the anti-mouse CD4 antibody (1:100) for 30 min at 4°C. Next,
 fix and permeabilize the cells using the FoxP3 Fixation/Permeabilization Kit according to the
 manufacturer's instructions. Finally, stain the cells with the anti-IL-17A antibody (1:100) at RT for 15
 min before FACS analysis [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S06 -->

#### Branch B: IL17A-IRES-GFP-KI mouse

1. (if cultured cells are from an IL17A-IRES-GFP-KI mouse, FACS analysis
 can be performed directly without the procedures described above in B). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S07 -->
